question: Related Questions Q. Recovery of already paid income taxes through future generated interest money. I'm a computer engineer working with a software company in Mumbai. Every year I'm required to pay income taxes to the Government of India from the salary which we earn through our hard work. This money which goes into the payment of taxes is quite substantial. As part of tax savings we do some investments like fixed deposit etc. Over a period of time I get some interest money on my fixed deposit amount. My question here is, would it be right if I use the interest money generated over my fixed deposit money to recover my loss in the form of tax payment. I'll give a scenario to better explain my thoughts: Suppose till the December 2009, I had paid taxes of Rs. 50000/- in total. Now at the start of January 2010, my bank gives me an interest of 30000/- on my fixed deposit money. Can I use this money on myself, with niyat that I'm recovering my 30000/- amount of total 50000/- paid in form of taxes. Would it be jayaz for me. answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 46469 Country: India Title: Distribution of property among sons and daughters. Question: I want to ask that my deceased parents had left two houses measuring 300 square yards. Now the value of the property is Rs. 80,00,000/- and the agreement is going to be done to sale the property. My parents did not have any debts (koi qarza nahi hai) to be given. We are 5 brothers and 5 sisters, all are married. My question is: How the property should be distributed among us as per the Shariah. Kindly guide us. Answer ID: 46469 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1161/902/B=9/1434) You should distribute the price of the house in 15 shares; out of which 2-2 shares shall go to each of the five brothers and 1-1 share to each of the five sisters, as per the rule mentioned in the Quran: للذكر مثل حظ الأنثيين (القرآن) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
